reasons: Quantity differs: the Datadog query measures postgresql.rows_fetched (rows fetched), but the candidate uses postgresql.tup_inserted (tuples inserted). The widget title mentions fetched/returned/inserted/updated, but this request's only query is rows_fetched.
Aggregation differs: the Datadog query is a plain avg of the raw metric with no rate function, while the candidate applies rate() over the inserted counter and then averages it.
The $scope template variable has no prefix and default '*', so dropping it is correct; the candidate's omission of it is fine.

Outcome is wrong: a candidate mapping to the inserted counter cannot be an exact translation of a fetched-rows query. The converter should either map to the OTel fetched-tuples metric if it is defined, or block with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING. The defined metrics do not include a fetched counter, so the candidate should not translate.
